reading.summary: Last Will and Testament of Ruth Calloway, declaring residence in Tampa, Florida. She nominates her daughter Dana Calloway as Personal Representative without bond, bequeaths $10,000 to her niece Aoife Calloway, and leaves the residue of her estate equally to her children Dana Calloway and Tom Calloway. Signed on June 12, 2019.

facts.label: Testator
facts.quote: I, Ruth Calloway, a resident of Tampa, Florida, being of sound mind, declare this to be my Last Will and Testament

facts.label: Personal Representative
facts.quote: I name my daughter, Dana Calloway, as Personal Representative of my estate, to serve without bond.

facts.label: Monetary Bequest
facts.quote: I give the sum of Ten Thousand Dollars ($10,000.00) to my niece, Aoife Calloway, of Cork, Ireland.

facts.label: Residuary Beneficiaries
facts.quote: I give all the rest, residue and remainder of my estate, in equal shares, to my daughter, Dana Calloway, and my son, Tom Calloway.

facts.label: Execution Date
facts.quote: Signed at Tampa, Florida, on the 12th day of June, 2019

facts.label: Witnesses
facts.quote:
Harlan Pennick
Witness, Tampa, Florida

June Abernethy
Witness, Tampa, Florida
